newsitem.title: NIGERIA: 34 killed in Nigerian motor accident.
newsitem.headline: 34 killed in Nigerian motor accident.

text.p: Thirty-four people died and 19 were injured when a lorry and a car collided on a highway in northern Nigeria, local newspapers reported on Thursday.
The independent Guardian said the accident occured on Tuesday along the Kano-Maidugari road when one of the vehicles was trying to overtake the other.
Road accidents are common in Nigeria. Two weeks ago 50 people including school children were killed when an articulated truck plunged into a motor park in the eastern city of Onitsha.
